test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bite your tongue
solution:
The correct answer is **"To avoid saying something". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Bite your tongue" **means to refrain from speaking, especially to stop oneself from saying something that might be inappropriate or hurtful. (जुबान को काटना - विशेषकर कुछ अनुचित या चोट पहुंचाने वाली बात कहने से रोकने के लिए खुद को रोकने का मतलब है।)

 
 
• Example: I had to bite my tongue to not argue with my boss in front of everyone.
 
 
 
• Explanation of the correct word: "To avoid saying something" literally means to refrain from commenting, speaking out, or responding, particularly to hold back words that might be unnecessary, controversial, or could lead to conflict. (कुछ नहीं कहने के लिए - विशेषरूप से अनावश्यक, विवादास्पद, या संघर्ष की ओर ले जा सकने वाले शब्दों को वापस रखने के लिए टिप्पणी, बातचीत करने, या प्रतिक्रिया व्यक्त करने से परहेज करना।)
 
 
• Example: She wanted to criticize the proposal outright, but decided to avoid saying anything until she had reviewed it more thoroughly.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• To scold someone verbally means to reprimand or criticize someone in spoken words. (किसी को मौखिक रूप से डांटना - किसी की मौखिक आलोचना या निंदा करना।)
 
• To drink very heavily implies consuming a large amount of alcohol in a short period of time. (बहुत अधिक पीना - कम समय में बहुत सारी शराब का सेवन करना।)
 
• To have something explored means to investigate or examine something thoroughly. (किसी चीज का पता लगाना - किसी चीज को गहराई से जांचना या परीक्षण करना।)
